sets.relationshipLabel: device and the component it always carries
sets.explanation: A camera without a lens or a projector without a lamp can't do its job — each device inherently carries this part.

sets.relationshipLabel: moments bracketing a span of filmmaking
sets.explanation: Opening and closing credits bookend a screening just as greenlight and wrap bookend a production.

sets.relationshipLabel: subject and the made image that stands for it
sets.explanation: A poster represents a film the same way a headshot represents a star — each is the image made to stand in for the real thing.

sets.relationshipLabel: safeguard that stops a specific harm
sets.explanation: A stunt double exists to prevent injury, and a completion bond exists to prevent a shutdown — each is a safeguard tied to one specific risk.

glossary.definition: A financial guarantee that pays back backers if money runs out before a job is finished.
